name: Timnath Serah
overview: Timnath Serah is a significant location given to Joshua as his inheritance, situated in the hill country of Ephraim. Scripture records that Joshua not only received this city according to the Lord's command but also built and dwelt there, establishing it as his home. Furthermore, it is the place where Joshua was buried, marking it as both a gift from God and a lasting memorial of his faithful leadership among the Israelites.
